verdict: Prismatic Evolutions has held its value better; Destined Rivals is cheaper to get into. PRIS25 70.64 (100 = Jan 2025) vs DR25 57.81 (100 = May 2025) at the Oct 5, 2026 mark (−29.4% in ~20 months vs −42.2% in ~16). Latest week −0.3% vs −0.6%; since Aug 24 −6.6% vs −12.8%. Top three sold-comp medians $1,893.66 vs $706.45 (Umbreon ex SIR $1,212.50, 30 sales Sep 25–Oct 8, vs Team Rocket's Mewtwo ex SIR $400.00, 30 sales Sep 20–Oct 7). Sealed asks Oct 8: ETB lowest ask $115.00 (22 live) vs $129.99 (26 live), booster bundle $50.99 (20) vs $71.99 (19).
